tool.name: Phage lysis gene caller
tool.description: find holins, endolysins and spanins (ESM-2 + classifiers)
tool.command: ## ASSUMPTION: the environment variable LYSIS_CALLER_HOME points at the holin-ml checkout ## (the directory containing scripts/ and models/). Set it in the Galaxy job conf (see README). ## It is escaped (\${...}) so Cheetah leaves it for the shell to expand at run time. python3 "\${LYSIS_CALLER_HOME}/scripts/32_predict_lysis.py" #if $input_source.input_type == 'proteins' --proteins '$input_source.proteins' #elif $input_source.input_type == 'genome' --genome '$input_source.genome' #elif $input_source.input_type == 'genbank' --genbank '$input_source.genbank' #end if --threshold $threshold --cassette-window $cassette_window --show-cassettes --out '$output'

param.name: input_type
param.label: Input type
param.option: Nucleotide FASTA (genome, contigs or MAG bin)

param.name: proteins
param.label: Protein FASTA
param.help: One row is reported per sequence (20-2000 aa). No positions, so no cassette calls.

param.name: genome
param.label: Nucleotide FASTA
param.help: Genes are called de novo with Pyrodigal, then scored.

param.name: genbank
param.label: GenBank file
param.help: Annotated CDS proteins are scored in genome order.

param.name: threshold
param.label: Call threshold
param.help: Minimum probability for a protein to receive a holin/endolysin/spanin call. Use 0.95 for high-confidence calls.

param.name: cassette_window
param.label: Cassette window (genes)
param.help: Holin, endolysin and spanin calls within this many genes are grouped as a lysis cassette (genome and GenBank input only).

tool.help:
**What it does**
Scans phage sequences for lysis genes: **holins**, **endolysins** and **spanins**. Each protein is embedded with ESM-2 (35M) plus handcrafted features and scored by three independent classifiers. The three genes are called independently, wherever they sit in the genome.
**Input modes (choose one)**
- *Protein FASTA*: each sequence is scored directly. No positions are known, so no cassette calls are made. - *Nucleotide FASTA*: a genome, contig or MAG bin. Genes are called de novo with Pyrodigal, then scored. Use this for raw assemblies with no annotation. - *GenBank*: the annotated CDS proteins are scored in genome order.
**Output (tabular)**
Columns: ``id, gene, product, start, stop, strand, length, P_holin, P_endolysin, P_spanin, call, cassette``.
- ``P_holin``, ``P_endolysin``, ``P_spanin`` are independent probabilities (0 to 1) that the protein belongs to each class. They do not sum to 1. - ``call`` is the class with the highest probability if it reaches the threshold, otherwise ``none``. - ``cassette`` is a number shared by genes that form a lysis cassette (holin, endolysin and spanin co-located within the cassette window). It is empty for protein FASTA input and for genes outside any cassette.
**How well it works**
Leave-one-genome-out average precision:
========== =================================== =========================== Gene Realistic (known family, new phage) Strict (never-seen family) ========== =================================== =========================== Holin 0.965 0.785 Endolysin 0.843 0.729 Spanin 0.834 0.729 ========== =================================== ===========================
Precision is about 0.75 at P >= 0.9, so use a threshold of **0.95** for high-confidence calls.
A hit in a novel family is a **shortlist, not a verdict**: confirm by synteny, domain/topology analysis and, ideally, experiment.
**Notes**
The first run downloads the ESM-2 weights (about 130 MB) unless the server has them cached.
